annotations.text:
Dense workstation direction.

Built on the real Calm Graphite tokens from crates/yantrik-design-tokens — same surfaces, text hierarchy, accent presets and 8px grid. Type is Barlow / Barlow Semi Condensed / JetBrains Mono; the app currently sets no font family at all, so that part is a proposal.

Every number shown is real: measured today or read out of the repo.

What changed from the concept desktop:

• single-letter dock icons → drawn SVG icons with labels
• empty centre → what the companion noticed, in the panel and the feed
• orb as centrepiece → companion state as a panel lane and a dock entry
• near-empty bar → workspaces, window, load, net, model, clock
• greeting → the working set: project, recent files, open threads

Why the bar no longer fills up:

The taskbar now grows with WINDOWS OPEN, not with apps installed — launcher button, then open windows with titles, then a few icon-only pins. All 49 scanned .desktop entries live behind the Apps button.

Blocker worth knowing: AppGridItem carries only `icon-char` — a single character. Real icons need that struct and DesktopEntry extended to hold an icon name, plus an icon theme to resolve it against.
